globalPreservationRules: Do not infer availability, discounts or delivery from historical brochure facts.
Use item-level JSON pointer and document pages; no cross-project or cross-stage reuse.
Presence/absence text matching is conservative and does not establish semantic absence; review existing equivalent wording before adding.
Preserve verified unit-specific and model-specific contexts, all form security and current owner pricing.
Use reviewed model source/audit files for dimensions; never compute a global range from conflicting model data.
Do not restore low-resolution rejected assets or historical model plans superseded by current audits.
Retain required core section even when content cannot be locally verified, with a short honest status; optional sections only when backed by real content.
